fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/api with an injected timer that is over budget once then under passes, one over budget three times fails, and the budget log records each attempt; the 50 ms budget constant is unchanged
fields.statement: The read-budget test times a read whose median is over its budget up to two more times and fails only if every attempt is over, logging each attempt, so a short spike of load from outside the test run does not fail make check
